label: copy-phase positional gate: short sequences (L=3 copy, L=4 2nd recall) and mid/late recall in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never during original input or on <DEL>, and never when recall_idx is 0. Firing is mostly positional. For L=3 it fires on about 98% of copy steps; the largest activations are on the second recall step of L=3 sequences. For L=4 it fires on recall_idx 2 (55% of those steps). It is almost silent for L=5. For L>=6 it fires on recall_idx >= 3 at rates of only 5-46% per cell (highest for L=9 recall 3), and token identity does not cleanly explain which steps fire (slight preference for out_tok h/i/0/2 and for more digits). The predicate covers 99% of activation mass but has precision of only about 0.2, so which of the long-sequence steps fire is still unexplained.
